description: Scrape a URL (e.g. a launch blog post or product page) and generate an email draft from its content. Returns subject, preview text, and HTML body.

apiKey.description: Send16 API key (overrides SEND16_API_KEY env var)

instructions.description: Additional guidance — e.g. 'announcement style, focus on the new feature'

url.description: Public URL to scrape and turn into an email

name: generate_email_from_url
